name: hbar-stable-checkout
description: Accept HBAR, settle in USDC: SaucerSwap swap with a Chainlink price floor and HCS receipts on Hedera.

steps.label: Run the contract tests (no network needed)
Add an ECDSA testnet key
steps.text: Copy packages/hardhat/.env.example to packages/hardhat/.env and set DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY, HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID and HEDERA_OPERATOR_KEY.

steps.label: Configure the web app
steps.text: Copy packages/nextjs/.env.example to packages/nextjs/.env.local and set HCS_TOPIC_ID and the same operator.
README.md covers the oracle math, HTS association, receipts and troubleshooting.
